meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: 数据科学家与产品经理在向高管汇报或制作投资者演示时，当面临数据枯燥难懂的痛点，使用此技能可套用“Setup-Conflict-Resolution”叙事框架，自动生成结合可视化与业务上下文的洞察报告，让非技术受众秒懂结论并驱动决策。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将枯燥数据转化为驱动决策的清晰叙事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把数据结论清晰传达给非技术决策者
copy.tagline_en: Turn dull data into decision-driving stories for non-technical audiences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain data insights to non-technical stakeholders and drive decisions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把原始数据套进「Setup-Conflict-Resolution」叙事框架，产出带可视化图表和业务背景的洞察报告，面向非技术受众。
howto.when: 当你向高管汇报、做季度业务回顾或准备投资者演示，需要把枯燥数据讲给非技术受众时接管。

say.text: 用 Setup-Conflict-Resolution 框架讲这组流失数据
帮我给投资者演示做一份带图表和业务背景的洞察报告
say.note: 产出可视化加业务上下文的报告

say.text: 把 Q4 业绩数据整理成一页高管汇报的故事
say.note: 先给结论，最后落到行动请求

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude fits raw data into the Setup-Conflict-Resolution narrative and produces insight reports combining visuals with business context for non-technical audiences.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you present analytics to executives, run quarterly business reviews, or prepare investor presentations for non-technical audiences.

say_en.text: Tell this churn data as a Setup-Conflict-Resolution story
say_en.note: It runs Setup, Conflict, then Resolution

say_en.text: Build an investor report with charts and business context
say_en.note: Produces an insight report with visuals

say_en.text: Turn our Q4 numbers into a one-page exec story
say_en.note: Leads with the insight, ends with the ask
